description.value: Coco Rico Café is a neighbourhood bistro and tapas bar on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, founded in 2004, offering a lively pub atmosphere built around house-made cocktails and fresh daily-delivered ingredients. The venue has both indoor and outdoor patio seating, is pet-friendly on the patio, and draws a loyal local crowd for brunch, dinner, and late-night drinks. Its central location on one of Vancouver's busiest pedestrian corridors makes it a convenient mid-ride stop for cyclists passing through the downtown core.
